topBullNews.title: Following Jensen Huang Exit, Investors Fear Nvidia’s AI Lead Will Collapse
topBullNews.summary: Even though Nvidia remains a massive holding and is forecasting up to 70% growth in its next fiscal year, the stock has been trading at a steep discount around 12 to 13 times forward earnings amid major leadership and competitive shifts. Following Jensen Huang’s departure, investors are wrestling with how deeply Nvidia's advantage was tied to his hands-on leadership, annual product cadence and supply chain relationships like its handshake deals with Taiwan Semiconductor. 24/7 Wall St. Analysts Eric Bleeker and Austin Smith examine what Nvidia might look like with Jensen Huang gone and why fears of a collapse are valid.
